titleEn: Minimum Path Cost in a Grid
title: 网格中的最小路径代价
summary: 从网格首行任一格出发，每行向下一行任一列移动，代价包含访问格值与由当前格值决定的移动费用，求到末行最小总代价。
insight: 逐行动态规划。dp[col] 表示到当前行该列的最小代价，从值 grid[row][col] 向下一行 next 的转移额外付 moveCost[value][next]+grid[row+1][next]。
pitfalls: 起点格与终点格值都计入代价
移动费用按当前格的值索引
首行可以从任意列开始

solutions.title: 逐行动态规划
solutions.idea: 保留到当前行每列的最优代价并全连接转移。
steps: 逐行建立 next 全为无穷
枚举当前 col 和下一列 nc，更新 dp[col]+moveCost[grid[row][col]][nc]+grid[row+1][nc]
返回末行 dp 最小值

code.java: class Solution { public int minPathCost(int[][] grid,int[][] moveCost){int columns=grid[0].length;int[] dp=grid[0].clone();for(int row=0;row+1<grid.length;row++){int[] next=new int[columns];Arrays.fill(next,Integer.MAX_VALUE);for(int column=0;column<columns;column++)for(int nc=0;nc<columns;nc++)next[nc]=Math.min(next[nc],dp[column]+moveCost[grid[row][column]][nc]+grid[row+1][nc]);dp=next;}return Arrays.stream(dp).min().getAsInt();} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun minPathCost(grid:Array<IntArray>,moveCost:Array<IntArray>):Int{val columns=grid[0].size;var dp=grid[0].clone();for(row in 0 until grid.size-1){val next=IntArray(columns){Int.MAX_VALUE};for(column in 0 until columns)for(nc in 0 until columns)next[nc]=minOf(next[nc],dp[column]+moveCost[grid[row][column]][nc]+grid[row+1][nc]);dp=next};return dp.minOrNull()!!} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int minPathCost(vector<vector<int>>& grid,vector<vector<int>>& moveCost){int columns=grid[0].size();vector<int> dp=grid[0];for(int row=0;row+1<(int)grid.size();++row){vector<int> next(columns,INT_MAX);for(int column=0;column<columns;++column)for(int nc=0;nc<columns;++nc)next[nc]=min(next[nc],dp[column]+moveCost[grid[row][column]][nc]+grid[row+1][nc]);dp=move(next);}return *min_element(dp.begin(),dp.end());} };
